title: A declared name is one edit away from `purrr`
description: renv.lock declares a locked package name in renv.lock within one edit of `purrr`. renv restores exactly these names, so a name that only looks like the intended package runs foreign R code in the analysis. The name this rule expects is `purrr`.
remediation: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `purrr`, correct it to that exact spelling.
limitation: It compares declared names with `purrr` by Levenshtein distance of one and reports a name that is not `purrr` itself; it cannot tell whether the similarly spelled package exists, who publishes it, whether it is malicious, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
